## Business rules
- The clinic owner has 5 tabs: "Hôm nay" / "Lịch hẹn" / "Hồ sơ" / "Theo dõi" / "Thêm". The bottom nav belongs to Workspace, not a global nav.

## Accepted differences from the canvas
- Real Pema logo instead of the canvas "pema" text.
- Real sample data (46 records) instead of illustrative names.

## Gotchas / notes
- The selected tab must be `rememberSaveable`: NavHost drops `remember` when pushing a child route, so coming back would reset to tab 0.
